title: The Oasis
description: A Minecraft modpack for The Oasis Discord server
body:
**The Oasis** is a lightly–modded survival experience designed to feel familiar while adding just enough new content to keep the world exciting, fresh, and full of discovery. Built originally for a small group of friends in our Discord server, this modpack focuses on creating a cozy survival environment with touches of technology to enhance progression without overwhelming the player.

At its core, **The Oasis** keeps the classic Minecraft survival experience intact. You’ll still explore, gather resources, build bases, and survive the dangers of the world—but now with more tools, quality-of-life tweaks, and light automation options that make long-term play smoother and more rewarding. The tech included in this pack isn’t meant to dominate the gameplay; instead, it supports your journey by offering simple machines, better storage, improved crafting, and helpful utilities that blend naturally with the survival loop.

Whether you’re building a peaceful home, exploring unexplored lands, or slowly upgrading your gear, The Oasis encourages you to progress at your own pace. It’s friendly for casual players, fun with friends, and perfect for multiplayer worlds. The goal was to create a place that feels comfortable—a kind of digital hangout spot where you and your friends can relax, talk, explore, and build together.

If you’re looking for a survival-focused modpack with just a hint of tech flavor and a warm, community-driven feel, **welcome to The Oasis.**
